items.name: Misdirect
items.effect: You turn an enemy's aim against itself. When an attack or ability would target you, you may send it to any enemy within your Trickery Mastery in spaces, and it resolves against that enemy instead. An attack redirected this way cannot be redirected again.

items.name: Center of Attention
items.effect: Every eye on the field is drawn to you. Enemies within your Presence Mastery in spaces cannot target your allies and must aim their attacks and abilities at you instead.

items.name: Dual Strike
items.effect: Your off-hand never rests. Whenever you make a weapon attack, use a weapon ability, or cast a spell, your other equipped weapon also strikes the same target for Bonus Damage equal to your Finesse Mastery. You must have two weapons equipped.

items.name: Overpower
items.effect: Your blows move bodies. Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you Push it directly away from you up to your Might Mastery in spaces.

items.name: Fleet
items.effect: You are always in motion. Each round you may move up to your Movement Mastery in spaces without spending your React, split before and after your Act as you like.

items.name: Steady the Line
items.effect: You hold your allies against any force. Allies within your Bearing Mastery in spaces may not be moved against their will, ignoring Pushed, Pulled, Swapped, Repositioned, and similar effects.

items.name: Unravel
items.effect: Your magic cuts through wards. Whenever you deal Magic damage, ignore an amount of the target's Resistance equal to your Weaving Mastery.

items.name: Lifegiving Presence
items.effect: Your soul sustains those around you. At the start of each round, you and every ally within your Spirit Mastery in spaces recover Vitality equal to your Spirit Mastery.

items.name: Conjuror
items.effect: You pull form out of nothing. Once each round you may Manifest a single object, barrier, or piece of cover in an empty space in range, up to your Creation Mastery in spaces in size and with Durability equal to your Creation Mastery. It lasts until the battle ends or it is destroyed.

items.name: Tireless
items.effect: Exhaustion barely touches you. Whenever you would gain Fatigue, reduce it by your Endurance Mastery, advancing that many fewer steps on the Fatigue track. At high enough Mastery you cannot gain Fatigue at all.

items.name: Full Mend
items.effect: Your care runs deep. Any healing you provide is multiplied by 1 plus your Renewal Mastery, and any ally you revive returns at full Vitality.

items.name: Spite
items.effect: Pain only sharpens you. While you are suffering any Affliction, your attacks are Lucky Rolls and your Bonus Damage is multiplied by 1 plus your Resolve Mastery.

items.name: Ever-Watchful
items.effect: Nothing reaches you unseen. You always perceive Obscured and hidden creatures and objects, you cannot be surprised, and any attack against you by a creature you cannot see automatically fails.

items.name: Read the Field
items.effect: You read a foe like a page. You always know the current Vitality, Charges, Resistance, Afflictions, Infusions, Augmentations, and abilities of any enemy you can see.

items.name: Recall
items.effect: You learn from every blow. Any spell or ability that strikes you during a battle is recorded, and for the rest of that battle you may use it as your own. You may keep a number of recorded spells and abilities equal to your Lore Mastery.

items.name: Quick
items.effect: You answer threats again and again. You may take additional Reacts each round equal to your Reflex Mastery.

items.name: Slip Free
items.effect: No bond holds you. You cannot be Immobilized or confined, you automatically escape any restraint or grapple, and whenever an attack misses you, you may immediately move up to your Elusion Mastery in spaces.

items.name: Unflappable
items.effect: You never lose your footing. You cannot be afflicted by Staggered or Disoriented, and you reduce the damage of the first attack against you each round by your Poise Mastery.

items.name: Bulwark
items.effect: You are a wall others hide behind. Allies within your Guard in spaces reduce all damage they take by your Guard.

items.name: Hardened
items.effect: The closer to death, the harder you are. While you are below half your maximum Vitality, you reduce all damage you take by your Temper.

items.name: Immovable
items.effect: Nothing shifts you. You cannot be moved against your will by any effect, including Pushed, Pulled, Swapped, and Repositioned.

items.name: Iron Mind
items.effect: Your will guards more than your own mind. You and allies within your Conviction Mastery in spaces cannot be afflicted by Frenzied or Terrorized.

items.name: Hallowed Vessel
items.effect: Your body and soul reject corruption. You cannot be afflicted by Harvested, and you recover Vitality equal to your Sanctum at the start of each round.

items.name: Attuned
items.effect: Magic slides off you. Reduce all Magic damage you take by your Resonance, and spells cannot apply Afflictions to you.
